source_title: Montana MCA 61-10-124 Special Permits & Fees; MDT Motor Carrier Services Permitting FAQ
verify_reasons: Single-trip fees confirmed from MCA 61-10-124 (statute fetched this run); the overweight per-mile schedule is set by MCA 61-10-124/-201 and rounds weight in 5,000-lb and distance in 25-mile increments — only the $10 oversize base and $10/up-to-100-mile overweight floor are codified here.

Escort thresholds are MDT's published width/height/length values (2-lane vs Interstate differ); the escort table itself is in MDT permit attachments — confirm per-route configuration with MDT Motor Carrier Services.
Montana publishes no single fixed dimensional superload threshold; extreme loads are handled by MDT engineering/structural review case-by-case (superload dims left null).

superload_thresholds.note: Montana has no single fixed dimensional 'superload' label. Loads beyond routine permit limits (extreme width/height/length or weight requiring bridge analysis) require advance coordination with MDT's Engineering and Permitting offices and approved routing. The handler flags very large loads for manual review rather than auto-clearing.

width.note: non-Interstate 2-lane: 1 front escort over 12'6" (Interstate: 1 escort over 16'6")

height.note: 1 escort with height pole over 17' high

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize single-trip permit = $10 per trip (MCA 61-10-124). Overweight single-trip is a weight/distance schedule (MCA 61-10-124/-201): $10 for distances up to 100 miles for over-gross-within-axle-limits loads, scaling by weight (rounded up to 5,000-lb increments) and distance (rounded up to 25-mile increments). Truck-trailer-trailer / platoon = $20/trip.
single_trip.note: Trip permits generally valid 3-5 days (temporary trip authority 72 hours for some categories).

annual.note: Term/annual oversize permit $75; non-divisible loads up to 120' annual $125; truck-trailer-trailer / platoon term $200 (MCA 61-10-124).

movement_restrictions: Oversize moves generally daylight-only (about 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset)
Holiday and adverse-weather (fog/ice/snow/high-wind) restrictions apply per permit conditions
notes: Overweight fee is weight-and-distance based (axle-group dependent), so a gross-weight-only verdict is indicative — confirm the MDT quote.
State-level rules only; county/city permits and bridge-specific engineering out of scope.
